basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old from Portland, Oregon, who has recently discovered a passion for wargaming. By day, I work as a graphic designer for a local marketing firm, and by night, I dive into the world of strategy games and niche online discussions. I'm single and enjoy the freedom of spending my weekends exploring new hobbies. My interests range from the intricacies of WWII alternate history scenarios to quirky online communities. I’m usually online in the evenings and weekends, often seeking mind-stimulating discussions or unwinding with a game.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge stems from a lifelong interest in history and storytelling, complemented by a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design. I have self-taught myself through online resources and community forums to better understand game mechanics and historical contexts, especially related to WWII.
